text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: p99 latency alert for tenant=veridianhealth on prod-us-west-2. p99 jumped to 12.4s over last 5m, p95 ~2.1s. Streaming stalls observed.
oncall-erin: I'm on it. paged. seeing a customer incident—VeridianHealth reported UI timeouts a few minutes ago. changing slack channel to #incidents.
sre-raj: grabbing graphs. p95 spike is modest but p99 tail huge. looks like a small cluster of sessions with huge token counts and repeated re-runs. stack: inference-runtime v2.8, kv-cache enabled, stream agent=grpc.
sre-raj: CPU and GPU utilization for serving pool1 (tenant-dedicated) are normal. however gRPC stream backlog is spiking and worker latency shows long stalls (~8-12s) around KV cache fetch.
eng-zoe: could be KV cache thrash with very long prefixes — we've seen this when prompts include long base64 blobs. any examples from Veridian?
support-ana: VeridianOps sent this example prompt in the tickets: "USER_CONTEXT_START
-----BEGIN-PAYLOAD-----
<very long base64 chunk 45000 chars>
-----END-PAYLOAD-----
USER_CONTEXT_END
" they batch 100 concurrent requests in a short window (ETL run).
eng-zoe: that, plus concurrent sessions, can cause a lot of KV lookups and massive memory churn in the prefix cache. streaming stalls happen when KV lookup blocks the token generation pipeline.
pm-lina: customer impact: several internal automation jobs timed out. Veridian reports ~30% of requests in the ETL window failed with UI 504s. They flagged this as P1.
veridian-ops: yep, we started seeing timeouts at 11:44 UTC. can we throttle or gate these ETL bursts? we need a short-term fix.
oncall-erin: immediate mitigations I can do now: 1) route Veridian traffic to the fallback model endpoint (smaller quantized model) to reduce KV pressure, 2) temporarily limit concurrency for tenant on dedicated pool, 3) evict prefix cache for that tenant. Any objections?
sre-raj: agree. also increase stream buffer and bump grpc max-concurrent-streams for the pool (safe short-term).
eng-zoe: step commands:
```bash
# route to fallback model (api)
redwood routes update --tenant veridianhealth --route /generate --model small-quant-v1 --priority emergency
# evict KV prefix cache for tenant
redwood kvcache evict --tenant veridianhealth --prefix "USER_CONTEXT_START"
# throttle concurrency
redwood quota update --tenant veridianhealth --concurrency 40
```
eng-zoe: I recommend disabling prefix caching for that tenant if evict isn't enough:
```yaml
tenant-config:
  veridianhealth:
    prefix_cache: disabled
```
support-ana: I'll message VeridianOps about the temporary route and throttle now.
veridian-ops: thanks — if you route to smaller model we'll validate tests. we can also delay our ETL job a bit while you mitigate.
pm-lina: communicate SLA impact and expected ETA for fix?
oncall-erin: ETA for mitigation steps 10-15m. I'll apply routes + evict now. monitoring for p99 to drop.
incident-bot: action executed: route update for tenant=veridianhealth at 3932100120 by oncall-erin.
eng-zoe: applied KV evict at 3932100150. started increasing grpc max concurrent streams on pool1.
sre-raj: initial effect: p99 dropped from 12.4s -> 3.6s within 90s of route change, streaming stalls reduced, error rate back to baseline. p95 steady ~1.8s.
veridian-ops: seeing big improvement on our side. thanks. we'll keep ETL delayed for another 20m and re-run with smaller payloads.
pm-lina: action items for postmortem: (1) root cause (long base64 payload + burst concurrency -> kv-cache thrash), (2) short-term mitigation timeline + customer comms, (3) long-term: tenant-level long-prompt protections, request-size warnings, smarter cache admission and abort on heavy prefix lookups, (4) add a canary that detects large prefix lengths and automatically rate-limits.
eng-zoe: assigned to eng-runtime to implement cache admission control and a per-tenant long-prefix reject policy. I'll pair with runtime infra on recommendations (quantization evictions, cache sizing).
sre-raj: for follow-up: add metrics for 'prefix-length histogram by tenant' and alert when tail length > X for > Y seconds.
oncall-erin: handing off ongoing follow-up to eng-zoe and sre-raj. I'm going offline for 20m but will monitor. PLEASE escalate in thread if p99 rises again.
veridian-ops: appreciate the quick action. please paste the exact commands you ran for our records.
eng-zoe: pasted above, will also DM support the audit of the route change and kv evict.
support-ana: I updated the Veridian ticket with mitigation steps and ETA. they acknowledged. :white_check_mark:
pm-lina: planning note: schedule a 30min sync with Veridian next week to discuss payload patterns and mitigation options (rate limits, ingestion transforms).
incident-bot: thread resolved alert: p99 under threshold for 10m at 3932100365. root cause still under investigation.
oncall-erin: marking handoff -> eng-zoe for postmortem. raz (sre-raj) and support-ana looped.
eng-zoe: will own the postmortem and follow up with action items and timeline.
veridian-ops: we will coordinate to sanitize the payloads and avoid embedding huge base64 blobs. thanks again.
